newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: FOUR S.AFRICAN MINERS DIE AT WESTERN DEEP .
newsitem.headline: FOUR S.AFRICAN MINERS DIE AT WESTERN DEEP .

text.p: Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd announced on Sunday that four miners had died at a gold plant west of Johannesburg, but said there was no suspicion they had been murdered.

"At this stage we have no reason to suspect foul play as a cause of their deaths," Anglo spokesman James Duncan told Reuters. "A full inquiry is under way and we will release that report when it's finalised."
The four miners died at a Western Deep Levels Ltd gold plant late on Saturday night.
They had been reported missing after a 10-minute breakdown at the Carletonville plant at about 20h00 GMT and their bodies were found inside one of the plant's mills early on Sunday.
"The four had no work-related reason to be inside the mill during the breakdown," Duncan said.
"The circumstances leading to their deaths, in particular how they gained unauthorised access to the mill, are being investigated."
Duncan added there had been no further breakdowns at the plant over the weekend.
